limits: Synthetic caller-supplied final usage, three neutral units per fixture; provider transport and inference are not exercised.
Each fixture has one unpaired reservation; the paired HTTP recovery evidence remains separate.
A cancelled ticket waiter does not cancel or consume the original accounting work.
Controlled causes validate diagnostic discrimination but do not identify the two retained spontaneous waits.
Stage/counter observations are not an atomic database view or authority for retries, dispatch or liability release.

publication.redactions: Private artifact locations and fingerprints, process identifiers and observed correlation values are omitted or aliased. Numerical results and useful public source/version references are retained.
publication.original_records: Unmodified operational records and original hashes are retained privately; this derivative is not a raw capture.
